book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: The Critical Failure of Dying
chapters.goal: Introduce Arthur and his accidental 'Glass Cannon' Isekai transition where every hit he lands is a crit, but he has exactly 1 HP.
chapters.stakes_shift: From mundane debt-ridden life to a high-stakes survival game where a stubbed toe means permadeath.

bridge.from_prev: Arthur's final moments in the real world during a freak electrical accident.
bridge.to_next: Arthur stands at the entrance of the 'Newbie Slums' with a glowing red warning over his head.

chapters.title: Tutorials are for People with HP
chapters.goal: Arthur must clear the basic combat tutorial without taking a single point of environmental or monster damage.
chapters.stakes_shift: Arthur realizes he can't play the game normally and must find 'exploits' in movement and stealth to survive.

bridge.from_prev: Arthur enters the tutorial zone with his 1 HP handicap.
bridge.to_next: Arthur discovers a hidden vendor who sells items that shouldn't be available to level 1s.

chapters.title: Exploiting the Economy
chapters.goal: Arthur uses his 100% crit rate to 'farm' high-level materials from passive mobs that usually require high-level parties.
chapters.stakes_shift: Arthur goes from a penniless 'glitch' to a wealthy outlier, attracting the attention of a local merchant guild.

bridge.from_prev: Arthur secures his first 'overkill' drop from a Crystal Tortoise.
bridge.to_next: A guild representative offers Arthur a 'deal' that smells like a trap.

chapters.title: Dungeon Diving on a Budget
chapters.goal: To avoid the guild's pressure, Arthur dives into a 'Death-Touch' dungeon where everything dies in one hit—including him.
chapters.stakes_shift: The environment itself becomes the enemy, shifting the focus from combat to precision platforming.

bridge.from_prev: Arthur enters the 'Shatter-Glass Crypt' to hide from guild enforcers.
bridge.to_next: Arthur accidentally triggers a party-requirement boss while solo.

chapters.title: Worst Party Member Ever
chapters.goal: Arthur is forced to team up with a naive Paladin who insists on 'protecting' him, which actually makes his stealth-based survival impossible.
chapters.stakes_shift: Arthur must manage another person's AI/behavior to keep himself from being collateral damage.

bridge.from_prev: The Paladin 'rescues' Arthur from a shadow, nearly crushing him with a heavy shield.
bridge.to_next: The duo reaches the final chamber where a boss with an 'Aura of Thorns' resides.

chapters.title: The Reflect Damage Problem
chapters.goal: Arthur faces a boss that reflects 1% of damage taken—a death sentence for a 1 HP crit-machine.
chapters.stakes_shift: Arthur has to find a way to deal damage without 'hitting' the boss or find a loophole in the System's math.

bridge.from_prev: The boss activates its Reflective Shell, halting Arthur's offense.
bridge.to_next: The boss falls to a mathematical technicality, but the System triggers a 'Balance Patch' alert.

chapters.title: Hit, Run, and Repeat
chapters.goal: Arthur must escape the dungeon before the System 'patches' his existence out of the world.
chapters.stakes_shift: Survival is no longer just about HP; it's about staying ahead of the System's administration.

bridge.from_prev: The world begins to pixelate as the 'Balance Patch' initiates.
bridge.to_next: Arthur escapes into a 'Legacy Zone' where the patch can't reach him, ready for the next exploit.

sections.title: The Short-Circuit
sections.intent: Establish Arthur's mundane life and the freak accident that triggers his transition.
sections.end_condition: Arthur's consciousness fades in the real world amidst electrical sparks.

sections.title: The Glitched Awakening
sections.intent: Arthur wakes in the system and discovers his impossible 1 HP / 100% Crit Rate status.
sections.end_condition: Arthur confirms the 'Glass Cannon' status is not a temporary UI bug.

sections.title: Slumming It
sections.intent: Arthur arrives at the Newbie Slums and realizes the immediate danger of his environment.
sections.end_condition: Arthur stands at the entrance of the Newbie Slums with a glowing red warning over his head.

sections.title: The Zero-Tolerance Zone
sections.intent: Arthur enters the tutorial and learns the movement mechanics required to avoid all damage.
sections.end_condition: Arthur reaches the first combat trial without losing his 1 HP.

sections.title: Precision Violence
sections.intent: Arthur uses his 100% crit rate to one-shot tutorial mobs before they can react.
sections.end_condition: The combat trial is cleared with a 'Flawless' rating.

sections.title: The Secret Shop
sections.intent: Arthur finds a hidden vendor exploit before leaving the tutorial zone.
sections.end_condition: Arthur discovers a hidden vendor who sells items that shouldn't be available to level 1s.

sections.title: Turtle Hunting
sections.intent: Arthur identifies high-level passive mobs that provide massive loot when overkilled.
sections.end_condition: Arthur locates the nesting grounds of the Crystal Tortoises.

sections.title: The Overkill Harvest
sections.intent: Arthur systematically farms the tortoises, generating rare material drops.
sections.end_condition: Arthur secures his first 'overkill' drop from a Crystal Tortoise.

sections.title: Market Disruption
sections.intent: Arthur attempts to sell his high-level loot, drawing unwanted attention from the merchant guild.
sections.end_condition: A guild representative offers Arthur a 'deal' that smells like a trap.

sections.title: Shadow Boxing
sections.intent: Arthur evades guild enforcers and flees into a restricted high-level dungeon.
sections.end_condition: Arthur enters the 'Shatter-Glass Crypt' to hide from guild enforcers.

sections.title: The Fragile Path
sections.intent: Arthur navigates the crypt where the environment is as deadly as the monsters.
sections.end_condition: Arthur reaches the heart of the crypt without triggering a single trap.

sections.title: Accidental Aggro
sections.intent: Arthur's attempt to hide leads him directly into a boss encounter meant for a full party.
sections.end_condition: Arthur accidentally triggers a party-requirement boss while solo.

sections.title: The Shield of Doom
sections.intent: A 'heroic' Paladin intervenes, nearly killing Arthur with 'protection'.
sections.end_condition: The Paladin 'rescues' Arthur from a shadow, nearly crushing him with a heavy shield.

sections.title: Incompatible Tactics
sections.intent: Arthur tries to use the Paladin as a distraction while maintaining his own stealth.
sections.end_condition: The duo survives a series of encounters despite the Paladin's loud approach.

sections.title: The Thorns Threshold
sections.intent: The party reaches the final boss, which possesses a lethal counter-mechanic.
sections.end_condition: The duo reaches the final chamber where a boss with an 'Aura of Thorns' resides.

sections.title: The Mirror Problem
sections.intent: Arthur realizes he cannot hit the boss without killing himself via reflected damage.
sections.end_condition: The boss activates its Reflective Shell, halting Arthur's offense.

sections.title: Weaponized Math
sections.intent: Arthur searches for a loophole in the damage calculation to bypass the reflection.
sections.end_condition: Arthur identifies a rounding error in the System's reflect logic.

sections.title: The Patch Trigger
sections.intent: Arthur defeats the boss using the exploit, causing the System to flag him as a bug.
sections.end_condition: The boss falls to a mathematical technicality, but the System triggers a 'Balance Patch' alert.

sections.title: Digital Decay
sections.intent: The world begins to break down as the System attempts to delete Arthur's character.
sections.end_condition: The world begins to pixelate as the 'Balance Patch' initiates.

sections.title: The Outrun
sections.intent: Arthur races through the collapsing dungeon toward an unpatched legacy zone.
sections.end_condition: Arthur reaches the boundary of the Legacy Zone with the patch at his heels.

sections.title: Legacy Escape
sections.intent: Arthur crosses into the safe zone, securing his existence and preparing for the next exploit.
sections.end_condition: Arthur escapes into a 'Legacy Zone' where the patch can't reach him, ready for the next exploit.
